title: Shinmai Maou no Testament: Loli Ero Succubus Maria no Characommentary Tsuki Hizou Eizou
justification: AniList: 6 shorts of 3 min, 2015-03-27 to 2015-08-28 (a monthly BD bonus). AniDB 10529 S1-S6 "Special 1-6" on 2015-03-27, 04-24, 05-29, 06-26, 07-31, 08-28 (S7-S8 are undated alternative endings, not in the run). TVDB 284719 season 0 0x3-0x8 "Special 1-6" on the same dates, and the parent's Anime-Lists mapping row (anidbseason 0, tvdbseason 0, start 1 end 6 offset 2) already places S1-S6 there. The titles are numbered ("Special N") so order and the six monthly dates decide, they agree on all six; no other AniDB special run of 6 monthly entries exists on the parent. The nodes sharing 284719 (11000, 11142 S1-S5 to 0x9-0x13, 11890, 13543) claim other season 0 episodes.
